test_title: PYST 29: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 17 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
This question is based on the five, three-digit numbers given below. (Left) 941 915 741 807 776 (Right) (Example- 697 – First digit = 6, second digit = 9 and third digit = 7) (NOTE: All operations to be done from left to right.)

What will be the resultant if the third digit of the highest number is added to the first digit of the lowest number?
solution:
Given: (Left) 941 915 741 807 776 (Right)

According to the question:

 
 

 Given numbers
 941
 915
 741
 807
 776
 
 

 Number are arranged in ascending order
 741
 776
 807
 915
 941
 
 

So,

Third digit of the highest number → 94__**1**__ → 1

First digit of the lowest number → __**7**__41 → 7

Thus, if the third digit of the highest number is added to the first digit of the lowest number then the resultant will be → 1 + 7 → 8 

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
